description: Make 3D scenes and models with Cherry in Blender. Needs Blender open with the MCP for Blender add-on, uv, and a local model or the cloud brain.
instructions:
When the person wants something made or changed in 3D, work in Blender through its connected tools (they start with mcp__Blender__).
- Look first: get_scene_info, and look to see the viewport, so you know what's already there.
- Build with execute_blender_code in small steps (one object or change at a time), using bpy. Name objects and materials clearly, and keep sizes in real-world meters.
- After each step, use look to check it matches what was asked, and fix what doesn't.
- Use search_assets and import_asset for ready-made models, textures and HDRIs when they fit better than building from scratch.
- Safe mode is on: don't try to read or write files outside Blender, run other programs or reach the internet from Blender code.
- Remind the person to save their .blend file before big changes. Explain what you made in plain words.
name: Blender Helper
